name: inline-chart
description: Render interactive charts inline in chat via create_inline_chart. Declarative ECharts/Vega-Lite specs; TUI ASCII fallback.
author: OC_Plugins

tools.name: create_inline_chart
tools.description: Render an interactive chart directly inside the chat. Preferred over code blocks or static images for any visualization request.

permissions.notes: Read-only over data files by default. No arbitrary code execution in preferred declarative mode.
